cards.title: Size and font
cards.body: `font-size` sets how big text is, often in `px`. `font-family` picks the font, with a backup after a comma.
cards.code: Bigger, fancier text.

hi.title: Size aur font
hi.body: `font-size` batata hai text kitna bada hai, aksar `px` mein. `font-family` font chunta hai, comma ke baad ek backup ke saath.

hi.title: Text ko line mein lagana
hi.body: `text-align` text ko line mein lagata hai: `left`, `center` ya `right`.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The heading should be much bigger, but nothing changes. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: Sizes need a unit. The browser ignores a bare `30`; write `30px`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Heading kaafi badi honi chahiye, par kuch nahi badalta. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: Sizes ko unit chahiye. Browser akele `30` ko ignore kar deta hai; `30px` likho.

check.question: Which property makes text bigger?
check.explanation: `font-size` is the real property; the others do not exist.

hi.question: Kaunsi property text ko bada karti hai?
hi.explanation: `font-size` asli property hai; baaki exist hi nahi karti.

exercise.prompt: Center the `<h1>` with `text-align`, and give paragraphs a `font-size` of `18px`.
exercise.promptHi: `text-align` se `<h1>` ko center karo, aur paragraphs ko `18px` ka `font-size` do.
